units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 52:4">Targ. Ps. LII, 4</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 7:20">Targ. Is. VII, 20</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Horayot 14a:6">Hor. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ ומקשה</he> is acute and inclined to raise questions.
<cite ref="Niddah 45b:17">Nidd. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>דח׳ טפי</he> that she is very bright (for her age).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 111b:10">B. Bath. 111ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>סכינא ח׳ דמפסקא וכ׳</he> a sharp knife which cuts verses apart (interpreting without regard to syntax).
<cite ref="Chullin 77a:6">Ḥull. 77ᵃ</cite> <he>דח׳ סכיניה</he> whose knife is sharp (who reasons well); <cite ref="Yevamot 122a:1">Yeb. 122ᵃ</cite> <he>דחריף סכינא</he>.

<cite ref="Megillah 7a:18">Meg. 7ᵃ</cite>, a. e. (prov.) <he>טבא חדא פילפלתא ח׳ וכ׳</he> one grain of pepper is worth more than a basketful of pumpkins, i.e. a reasoning mind is worth more than learning.

<cite ref="Nedarim 31b:1">Ned. 31ᵇ</cite> top <he>זבינא ח׳</he> goods which sell quickly, v. <cite ref="M01280"><he>מִיצְעָא</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="H01058"><he>חֲרִיפִין</he></cite>, <he>חֲרִיפֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joshua 5:2">Targ. Josh. V, 2</cite>. Targ.
<cite ref="Berakhot 59b:5">Ber. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>האי דח׳ בני וכ׳</he> the reason that the men of Maḥuza are acute.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 39a:2">Kidd. 39ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>ח׳ דפומבדיתא</he> the ingenious students of Pumb’ditha (Efa and Abimi); a. e.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 44a">B. Mets. 44ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>כספא דח׳</he> silver coin which is current, is considered coin, gold being less current is considered a produce.—Pl. <he>חֲרִיפֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 44a">Ib.</cite> <he>ח׳ טפי וכ׳</he> are easier passed than &c.
